correctness.rationale: Explicit holomorphic basis using valuations and Riemann-Hurwitz; Cartier coefficient extraction from F^3 and F matches independently coded polynomial arithmetic. The scalar of the semilinear Cartier square, raised to its 25th power, is P; nonzero gives stable image dimension two, zero makes Cartier nilpotent. Algebraic factorization after shift proves no smooth rank-one Cartier case. Gauss lemma with a quadratic coefficient discriminant specialized to 4t^2+3 proves absolute irreducibility. Smooth F5 examples with nonzero discriminants and nonzero partial derivative establish the proper, generically smooth divisor. Exhaustive GF5 and sampled GF25 checks corroborate but are not used as geometric proofs.
